title: God Rest Ye Merry, Gentlemen
extraInfo: Engelsk folkelig julesang (carol), som kendes fra skillingstryk fra 1700-tallet, men formentlig er ældre. Kommaet i titlen står efter »merry«: »God rest you merry« betyder »Gud holde jer glade«. Sangen nævnes i Charles Dickens’ »A Christmas Carol« fra 1843, hvor en dreng synger den ved Scrooges dør.
verses: To save us all from Satan's power
O tidings of comfort and joy,
O tidings of comfort and joy.
How that in Bethlehem was born
The Son of God by name:
O tidings of comfort and joy,
O tidings of comfort and joy.
O tidings of comfort and joy,
O tidings of comfort and joy.
But when to Bethlehem they came,
They found Him in a manger,
O tidings of comfort and joy,
O tidings of comfort and joy.
Now to the Lord sing praises,
And with true love and brotherhood
O tidings of comfort and joy,
O tidings of comfort and joy.
